## Purpose

Describe the user-visible value of this change in one or two sentences.

## Release identity

- Asset/component:
- Version or document revision:
- Source/provenance:
- Target release class: `AUTO_RELEASE` / `AUTO_RELEASE_AFTER_IQA` / `HUMAN_GATE`

## Scope

- [ ] Exact added/changed/removed files are declared.
- [ ] Complete candidate delta was compared with the declared scope.
- [ ] No unrelated composition changes are borrowing credibility from passing tests.

## Evidence

- [ ] Positive checks pass.
- [ ] Negative/fail-closed checks pass where relevant.
- [ ] Clean-consumer/use check passes where relevant.
- [ ] Independent QA is attached when the release class requires it.
- [ ] Candidate/PASS/RELEASED/SUPPORTED states are not conflated.

## Public boundary

- [ ] No credentials or secrets.
- [ ] No private host/path/topology detail without explicit public value and approval.
- [ ] No customer/company/private data.
- [ ] No Protected Core source, protected eval corpus, or proprietary failure intelligence.
- [ ] Third-party rights and attribution are clear.
- [ ] Public claims are narrower than or equal to the supporting evidence.

## Compatibility and release

- [ ] API/state/lifecycle/permissions/dependency/license changes are explicitly called out.
- [ ] Version bump is appropriate for the actual compatibility delta.
- [ ] Rollback/supersession path is known.
- [ ] Public readback/receipt will be captured after merge/release.

## Unsupported claims

List what this change does **not** prove.
